name: 6v6 teacher distillation: dataset collection and latent student training
authority: PI, 2026-09-06: 'authorize the bounded distillation work now: write and freeze the 6v6 distillation dataset spec and verify the exact collection/distillation commands, but do not collect rows until the real 6v6 specialist checkpoints exist.'

timing_disclosure.when: written before any 6v6 specialist checkpoint exists, before any 6v6 state is collected, and before any 6v6 student is trained.
visible_when_written: the 6v6 specialist A/B smokes (5k steps, non-scientific, both PASS with the size-normalized pole verified from live BT tensors)
the complete 2v2 distillation record it is modelled on
NOT_visible_when_written: any 6v6 specialist checkpoint, its fidelity, or any 6v6 distillation or crossover outcome

PRECONDITIONS_ALL_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ANY_RO: 6v6 strategic demand CERTIFIED -- satisfied (GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2, delta_A +0.2656 [+0.0938,+0.4375], delta_B +0.6250 [+0.4844,+0.7500])
pi_A_6v6 and pi_B_6v6 terminal checkpoints EXIST, frozen, with recorded sha256 -- NOT satisfied; these are the school-PC training outputs
each specialist's training manifest shows the size-normalized pole resolved at min_alive_for_defender=6 from core._bt_resolved_profile_tensors()

TEACHERS.pi_A_6v6: trained against Pole A (OP6 + overlay min_alive_for_defender=6)
TEACHERS.pi_B_6v6: trained against Pole B (OP7 + overlay min_alive_for_defender=6)
TEACHERS.sha256_recorded_at_collection_time: both checkpoints' sha256 are written into the dataset manifest and re-verified by the distillation runner, exactly as the 2v2 path does
TEACHERS.single_strategy_required: both teachers must be non-latent; a latent-conditioned teacher is refused

DATASET.states_from_both_deployments: roll pi_A_6v6 against Pole A and pi_B_6v6 against Pole B (their natural deployments), EQUAL episode counts per pole. Deterministic teacher actions. Every visited pre-action state stored with the exact observation dict the policies consume (grid, vec, agent_mask, mask, global_state) plus the live decision mask.
DATASET.decision_rows_only: rows where no agent is free to commit contribute nothing to the loss by construction and are not stored
DATASET.decision_mask_source: rl.causal_supervision.decision_mask_from_core(core, 6, side='blue') -- fatal if the predicate is missing, and it ASSERTS the live tick tensor carries 6 agents
DATASET.teacher_targets_not_cached: both teachers are queried on every stored state at training time through the same masked-head code path the student uses

SEEDS.crossover_eval: reserved, to be frozen in a separate record when the student exists -- NOT allocated here, because allocating an evaluation block before the artefact under test exists invites reuse pressure
SEEDS.disjointness_verified: exact-literal grep of 13600001 / 13600096 / 13600101 / 13600196 / 13620001, and the patterns 136000[0-9]{2} and 136001[0-9]{2}, against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/ and artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/: ZERO hits. Verified immediately before this record was committed.

LOSS.evaluated: per action head over MASKED distributions, averaged over decision-boundary heads only
LOSS.same_states: both teachers are queried on the SAME states, so the difference between z0 and z1 is teacher strategy rather than state distribution
LOSS.actor_only: only actor parameters are optimized; critics are excluded and verified immobile
LOSS.no_reinforcement_learning: no PPO, no reward, no returns, no GAE, no value targets. A purely supervised runner.
LOSS.z_assignment: z0 <- pi_A_6v6, z1 <- pi_B_6v6. Frozen; never flipped.

TRAINING.schedule: 20 fixed epochs, batch 256, lr 3e-4, clip 1.0, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, TERMINAL WEIGHTS ONLY -- identical to the 2v2 offline TD run and every ladder rung
TRAINING.fit_check_floor: teacher-state holdout agreement >= 0.50 for both z before any evaluation is opened
TRAINING.fidelity_band: NOT INHERITED from the 2v2 ladder. The 0.957/0.979 band was anchored on 2v2 students and has no standing at 6v6, where teacher agreement has never been measured. A 6v6 comparability band may only be frozen once at least two converged 6v6 students exist to anchor it; until then 6v6 fidelity is reported as a continuous descriptive quantity with no band.

TEAM_SIZE_PROPAGATION.why_it_needs_saying: the distillation CORE is already team-size generic (rl.teacher_distillation derives n_agents from decision_mask.shape[1]; rl.causal_supervision asserts it), but two module globals are NOT, and one of them is not caught by any name-based sweep.

named N_AGENTS, not AGENTS -- train_scale.py's _propagate_team_size sweep does NOT catch it

TEAM_SIZE_PROPAGATION.verified_mechanism: experiments/collect_distillation_states_scale.py --check-only proves both reach the live env at N and that decision_mask_from_core REJECTS a deliberate agent-count mismatch (verified at N=4 and N=6)

OUTPUTS.dataset_manifest: TEACHER_DISTILLATION_6V6_DATASET.json (status FROZEN_DATASET), mirroring the 2v2 manifest's shape: teachers with sha256, seeds, device, per-shard decision_rows, totals
OUTPUTS.student: TEACHER_DISTILLATION_6V6_STUDENT_FROZEN.json + a terminal checkpoint with recorded sha256
OUTPUTS.separation_from_2v2: no 6v6 artefact may overwrite or be written into a 2v2 path. The 2v2 dataset manifest, student record and state directory are untouched.

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: collecting any 6v6 state row (blocked until the specialist checkpoints exist)
allocating the 6v6 crossover evaluation seed block
any change to the loss, schedule, or z assignment
SEQUENCE: freeze this spec -> (school PC) train pi_A_6v6 and pi_B_6v6 to their terminal checkpoints -> freeze both with sha256 -> collect the dataset on the blocks above -> freeze the dataset manifest -> distil 20 epochs -> freeze the student -> freeze a crossover eval block in a separate record -> evaluate
